project.title: YojanaLens — Auditable Scheme Eligibility Agent
project.short_description: An agent that decides Indian welfare-scheme eligibility with deterministic SQL rules inside IBM Db2, using native vector search to ground every explanation. The LLM never decides, citations are validated, and every verdict is replayable from a stored decision trace.

members.name: Aditya Lobhe
members.role: Full stack, data, Db2 schema, agent, tests and docs

features_used: Foreign Keys with ON DELETE CASCADE
Vector / JSON Search (native VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) and VECTOR_DISTANCE with COSINE)

ai_models: Any OpenAI-compatible LLM for narration (default: llama-3.3-70b-versatile; IBM Granite supported via the same client)
